A_PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.design: db/custody/pre-node-boundary.ts: a fixed PowerShell script (pinned by sha256 in the plan and in execution authority v1.0.3) that the operator's shell runs BEFORE any Node process exists. (1) Refuses, case-insensitively, every NODE_*, OPENSSL_*, SSL_CERT_FILE/DIR, LD_PRELOAD/LD_LIBRARY_PATH/LD_AUDIT, DYLD_*, the operator variable and a pre-set boundary mark (exit 64, PRE_NODE_AMBIENT_RUNTIME, names only). (2) Verifies the node binary against its planned sha256 (Get-FileHash) and the launcher next to it. (3) Starts node with NO flags, EnvironmentVariables.Clear() + the allowlist (SystemRoot, windir, PATH, TEMP, TMP) + the mark (the script's own sha256), UseShellExecute false (console inherited), and propagates the exit code.
A_PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.not_claimed: Checking NODE_OPTIONS from inside an already-started node does not solve NB-1 and is not claimed to: the launcher's OC-15 check (mark, empty execArgv, no NODE_* variable) is defence in depth only, and refuses a direct start AFTER any preload has already run.
A_PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.direct_invocation: The one authorized command is the boundary command printed by the gate (execution authority v1.0.3 the_only_authorized_command); a direct `node launcher.js` is refused by OC-15 (CHANNEL_NO_PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY) before any prompt.
A_PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.measured: tests/custody/d1-pre-node-boundary.test.ts 18/18 with the REAL powershell.exe and a preload that records its execution and tries to capture the synthetic operator string. Control WITHOUT the boundary: node -r preload executes and captures (the attack is real). THROUGH the boundary with NODE_OPTIONS=--require / --import (upper and lower case), NODE_PATH, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED, NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA, OPENSSL_CONF, SSL_CERT_FILE, SSL_CERT_DIR: refused before node starts, PRELOAD_EXECUTIONS_BEFORE_GOVERNED_SECRET = 0. A node binary that is not the pinned one: PRE_NODE_NODE_NOT_PINNED. Step (3) measured on the process the boundary starts (a stand-in at the launcher path reports its environment): only the allowlist and the mark reach node, an inherited non-hostile canary does not, execArgv is empty. Positive: clean console -> launcher READY, TOOL_SPAWNED, the tool runs, no preload ran.
A_PRE_NODE_BOUNDARY.plan_and_gate: The plan carries nodeExecutable {path, sha256} and preNodeBoundarySha256; verifyPlan re-derives both; the gate writes the boundary script next to the plan and STOPs when the script or node binary are absent or differ.

B_OEP1_CHAIN.design: OEP-1 evidence class V4 (execution authority v1.0.3 OEP1_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT): each record carries record_id, candidate {commit, package_closure_digest}, observed_at_utc, content_digest (sha256 of canonical JSON without itself), predecessor {record_id, content_digest} (null for the first), verdict, the facts and the derivation_context they were judged under, and acknowledges [{record_id, content_digest, resolution}].
B_OEP1_CHAIN.closing_rules: A closing PASS requires: every predecessor exists and its digest matches (recomputed); one root, acyclic, no fork, no gap, unique ids; strictly increasing UTC along the chain; the head observed after every record it acknowledges; each link's verdict RECOMPUTED from its facts and derivation context (a recorded string may only agree; a missing verdict agrees with nothing); every earlier link that does not recompute to CLOSED acknowledged exactly, with digest and resolution; the head bound to the channel certification event's candidate commit and package digest. Git history: a record deleted or modified after being committed fails closed (git log --full-history -m --diff-filter=DMRT); outside git the chain is UNVERIFIABLE, not PASS.
B_OEP1_CHAIN.no_latest_wins: No rule selects by filename or version: the head is the unique record no other record names as predecessor, and the whole chain is evaluated.
B_OEP1_CHAIN.measured: tests/custody/d1-oep1-evidence-chain.test.ts 21/21 (positive chains; N-1 head before the FAIL it acknowledges; strict order; deletion; substitution; alteration; fork; cycle; lying verdict; duplicate id; acknowledgement digest; O11; disk and git-history deletion/modification; non-git unverifiable) and the PMR-14 controls in tests/custody/d1-pre-hc1-post-mint.test.ts (another candidate, another package, other derivation facts).
